integrity: The discriminant and root-order arguments are exact algebra; the Bessel-convolution check uses the transform formula printed in the source. Numerical plots and root approximations are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the exact upstream linearization and the logical validity of the Section 6 contradiction step; it does not prove a complete nonlinear wave classification.
Finite overshoot away from the upstream asymptotic region is not ruled out.
An unindexed equivalent correction remains a bibliographic residual risk.
title: Real upstream spectrum defeats the linear oscillation obstruction in a pseudo-parabolic Fisher--KPP wave
